description: Ask a question in the live interview in progress on the user's behalf: the text is treated as the interviewer's question and answered on the interview page; if the AI is answering, that answer is interrupted first. Uses the same path as "Voice ask" in the desktop app and requires the user to have clicked "Start interview". Billed by time online. Requires the user to have this session open in the browser or desktop app and connected; the page carries it out exactly as if the user clicked the matching button. Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)
name: ask_live_interview
